'''Jun'ichi Kanemaru''' (Japanese: '''金丸淳一''' ''Kanemaru Jun'ichi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Kanemaru was born on October 27, 1962 in {{wp|Kofu, Yamanashi|Kofu}}, {{wp|Yamanashi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. Kanemaru's only role in {{aniseries|PTS}} was [[Harley]] during {{aniseries|RS}}. Kanemaru is currently affiliated with {{wp|81 Produce}}, and he is also a professional English teacher in his spare time.
